selection_status: All nine patches visually inspected in per-sensor top/side and oriented views before measurement; west ground strip rejected for mixed/curved surface; facade normal bands widened uniformly to avoid clipping sensor offsets.
basis_convention: normalize normal, orthogonalize tangent_u; tangent_v=cross(normal,tangent_u), facade v usually negative z; select absolute local coordinates <= half_widths_uvn
